in_sanskrit.name: श्रीनु

in_marathi.name: Sreenu
in_marathi.long_meaning: Sreenu हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Sreenu is derived from the Sanskrit word 'Sri', which means 'God's Grace' or 'Fortune'. The name is also associated with the Goddess Lakshmi, who is the goddess of wealth and prosperity in Hindu mythology.
